description: This file defines Express routes for development and debugging purposes, including endpoints for checking database status, seeding sample data into multiple collections, verifying data, and seeding LLM costs. It imports models and utilities, and exposes several API endpoints under /api/dev/ for internal use.

methods.name: GET /api/dev/db-status
methods.description: Returns the status of the MongoDB connection, including connection state, database name, and host.

methods.name: GET /api/dev/seed
methods.description: Seeds sample data into users, sample, session_tracking, app_deployments, tenants, and projects collections if they are empty, and returns counts and sample documents.

methods.name: GET /api/dev/verify
methods.description: Verifies data availability by returning counts and first few documents from all collections.

methods.name: GET /api/dev/seed-llm-costs
methods.description: Seeds 90 days of LLM cost data for multiple models if the collection is empty, and returns counts and a sample document.
